biography: Liam Fernandez burst onto the karting scene in South Korea at the age of 10, a whirlwind of raw talent fueled by an almost reckless abandon. His father, a former mechanic, mortgaged their small apartment to buy him a used kart after witnessing Liam consistently outperform older, more experienced drivers at a local rental track. Liam’s aggressive style quickly turned heads, but it also led to numerous crashes and mechanical failures, earning him the nickname 'Chaos'. He transitioned to single-seaters at 16, funded by a patchwork of small sponsorships and his father's tireless work. A defining moment came at the Formula Eastern Championship race at Sepang, where, despite starting last due to a mechanical issue in qualifying, he carved his way through the field to finish third, showcasing his exceptional overtaking skills. Now at 18, Liam competes as an independent driver, navigating the challenges of funding and equipment with a relentless drive to prove himself on the international stage. He's currently seeking a seat in a Formula 3 team, hoping to make the leap to the big leagues.
drivingStyle: Liam's driving style is characterized by an aggressive, almost flamboyant approach. He attacks corners with maximum commitment, often pushing the car to its absolute limit. His tire management is a work in progress, as his early aggression sometimes leads to late-race struggles. However, he thrives under pressure, often pulling off daring overtakes in crucial moments. He has a knack for finding grip where others can't, and his raw speed is undeniable, though sometimes tempered by a need for greater consistency.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: A clash of egos and driving styles. Bellini, a calculated and precise driver, publicly criticized Liam's aggressive tactics, leading to several on-track incidents and heated exchanges in the media.

rivalries.name: Anya Petrova
rivalries.reason: Both are rising stars, and their frequent battles for podium positions have created a fierce but respectful rivalry, pushing each to constantly improve.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Tanaka represents the established order, a veteran driver with years of experience. Liam views him as a benchmark and is determined to prove he can surpass him.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of worn-out racing gloves his father gave him for his first karting race.
Listens to K-Pop at full volume in the paddock before every session to 'get the energy flowing'.
Has a pre-race ritual of drawing a small smiley face on his steering wheel with a permanent marker.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser. You race to win, or you don't race at all."
careerHighlight: His podium finish at the Formula Eastern Championship at Sepang, where he climbed from last place to third, showcasing his raw talent and unwavering determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Korean National Karting Championship in 2021 due to over-aggression, costing him the title.
